en.title: A Battery Warranty Due-Diligence Framework for Chinese EVs Sold into Southeast Asia
en.seo_title: Chinese EV Battery Warranty Due-Diligence for Southeast Asia: A Verification Framework
en.meta_description: A due-diligence framework for a Chinese EV battery warranty in Singapore or Malaysia: separate written entitlement from battery condition, pass national registration and type-approval gates, and document flood exposure. Exact OEM warranty terms still require model- and country-level confirmation.
en.summary: Separate the written commercial entitlement from the pack's physical condition. Singapore's registration gate and Malaysia's whole-vehicle type approval apply before any warranty question, but neither a national approval rule nor a global battery-durability regulation is a manufacturer warranty. This page is a verification framework; exact OEM terms must be obtained per model and country.
en.method: A procurement due-diligence framework built from official Singapore LTA and Malaysia JPJ admission sources; international technical and market materials are background only. Bounded to Singapore and Malaysia.
en.ai_disclosure: Prepared by the AutoBridge Export Editorial Team with AI assistance for source organization, drafting, revision and translation. This is AI-assisted independent review, not human editorial sign-off; final editorial review is pending.
en.evidence_boundary: No first-hand inspection, transaction, interview or ownership is claimed. No OEM battery-warranty term, capacity-retention threshold, transferability, territory or water-exclusion clause was captured and none is asserted; local workshop capability and other Southeast Asian consumer regimes are not verified.

zh.title: 中国电动车东南亚电池保修尽职调查框架（新加坡、马来西亚）
zh.seo_title: 中国电动车东南亚电池保修尽调：一套核验框架
zh.meta_description: 面向新加坡或马来西亚的中国电动车电池保修尽调框架：把书面权利与电池物理状态分开，先过国家注册与型式认证关口，并规范记录水浸。确切 OEM 保修条款仍须逐车型、逐国家确认。
zh.summary: 把书面商业权利与电池包物理状态分开。新加坡注册关口与马来西亚整车型式认证先于任何保修问题，但国家准入规则与全球电池耐久性法规都不是厂家保修。本页是核验框架，确切 OEM 条款须逐车型、逐国家取得。
zh.method: 基于新加坡 LTA 与马来西亚 JPJ 官方准入来源搭建的采购尽调框架，国际技术与市场材料仅作背景；表述限定于新加坡与马来西亚。
zh.ai_disclosure: 由 AutoBridge Export Editorial Team 编写，AI 协助完成来源整理、起草、修订与翻译。这是 AI 辅助的独立审阅，并非人工编辑签发，最终编辑审阅仍在进行中。
zh.evidence_boundary: 本页不主张任何一手检测、交易、采访或持有经历；未采集、也不主张任何 OEM 电池保修期限、容量保持率门槛、可转让性、地区范围或进水免责条款；本地维修能力与其他东南亚国家消费者制度均未核实。
